findings.title: No test for create_initial_version carrying deselected tools
findings.problem: assistant_version_service.py:70 copies deselected_default_tools=request.deselected_default_tools or [] into version 1, but no test asserts it; the carry-through test file covers create_new_version, rollback, migration and compare only.
findings.impact: If the line regresses, a new assistant's version 1 has an empty list and rollback or config reads silently re-enable search_kb / repo-tree / code-search. Reachability of the regression is unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Add a create_initial_version test building AssistantRequest(deselected_default_tools=['search_kb']) and asserting the AssistantConfiguration is constructed with that value.
findings.check_notes: test_create_initial_version_carries_deselected_default_tools added; asserts AssistantConfiguration kwarg equals ['search_kb']; source line 70 present
